description: POI category names follow the rules locale of the map (fr_FR) (#25941). A French phrase is a category only as a whole: 'Paris' is the city and its places, not a word of 'Preneur de paris' (bookmaker), which still finds the bookmakers. 'Cafe Paris' is the cafe category in Paris, then the cafes named Paris; 'Restaurant et café' is cafe_and_restaurant for all three words, although 'restaurant' and 'café' are English names too; English stays for every map ('Bank'). The negative cases 'Billa' and 'Kino' are covered by SpatialPoiCategorySynonymsTest.
